name: Udp → Write
description: To write data to the UDP port, use the `udp.write` action. This action takes a single argument, the data to write to the UDP port.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: The id of the UDP component to use. If there is only one UDP component, this can be omitted.

config_entries.label: Data
config_entries.description: The data to write to the UDP port.
